source_selection: All ways in SPEED motor-road classes, all ferry route objects and all restriction relations; retain dependencies, original tags and metadata; ferry/restriction inventory remains outside routing
profile: Same class/maxspeed/surface scenario and repaired access priority as 2026; explicit winter/ice/seasonal/access-conditional exclusions; additional explicit direction precedence correction and unsupported/conditional direction exclusions preregistered
direction_correction: oneway:motorcar > oneway:motor_vehicle > oneway, explicit no overrides roundabout/motorway default; yes/-1 honored; unsupported alternating/reversible values excluded
direction_policy_confound: Paired road chronology comparison includes this explicit direction policy improvement; do not attribute every difference solely to source year unless same profile is rerun on both years
speed: OSM maxspeed where numeric; otherwise inherited class defaults; surface penalty; min5/max130 scenario, no traffic observation
snaps: Nearest among all accepted 2021 road geometry vertices before compression; protect every current full-axis+external point snap as graph junction; snap<=10km accepted;15km/h direct connector explicit separate scenario
compression: Endpoints + repeated source vertex IDs + all snapped source IDs retained; sum measured haversine lengths along underlying way, retain parallel arc minimum rather than sum
component_policy: Keep all directed weak components, no invented bridges/ferry times; inventory weak/strong components
destination_access_policy: destination-tagged roads retained, no through-traffic enforcement; explicit limitation
storage: Full3GB source and working arrays only /tmp tmpfs. Durable reference-complete filtered source split90MB pieces; no fullraw overlay download. Release temporary raw/index only after durable source verification and independent audit coordination.

snap_tie_prerun_amendment.policy: Query2nearest source vertices; chord-distance tie tolerance1e-14. For ties enumerate all equal-distance source nodes and choose lowest OSMnodeID deterministically. Retain candidate list/tie flag; no claim chosen node is observed road attachment.
